test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’**

The little girl chatters away as she __hurry up__ the road with her mother.
solution: The erroneous part of the sentence is: **hurries down ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Replace **'hurry up'** with **'****hurries down'** to make the sentence correct. • **Hurry up** means to move or do things more quickly than normal or to make someone do this.(चीजों को सामान्य से अधिक तेजी से आगे बढ़ाना या करना या किसी से ऐसा करवाना) • **Example -** *Hurry up! We're going to be late.* • Marked option "**Hurries down**" means to physically descend to some place or thing as quickly as one can.(जितनी जल्दी हो सके शारीरिक रूप से किसी स्थान या चीज़ पर उतरना) • **Example - ***She hurries down the gravel path to the feed barn.* • the** 's' **is only added to regular verbs in the present tense when the subject of the verb is a **third-person singular subject**. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. **Corrected sentence: ***The little girl chatters away as she hurries down the road with her mother.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • The phrasal verb** "hurry on"** means to continue speaking without giving anyone else time to say anything.(किसी और को कुछ भी कहने का समय दिए बिना बोलना जारी रखना) • **Example -** *She hurried on before he could interrupt her.* 13c:Tad2, The correct answer is: **Cyclone Amphan has devastated hundreds of villages in West Bengal.**
